title: Implementar runner CI browser para Student World → Jose
mission: Implement a deterministic GitHub Actions/Playwright runner for the existing Student World -> Jose live-route canary so repository workers without a representative browser can obtain honest desktop+narrow runtime evidence. Reuse the existing canary and verification contract; do not change the implementation or any Current/Catalog/Human Accepted/Served pointer.
definition_of_done: Add a deterministic Playwright test plus bounded GitHub Actions workflow targeting the exact published Student World -> Jose canary.
Run representative desktop and narrow/mobile JavaScript views and record exact public URL, HTTP status and observed source identity/drift.
Verify the embedded current Student World renders from the pinned donor, Rutas Jose opens/closes, Escape closes it, and resize does not strand the control.
Verify both Jose Study and Jose Algebra navigation targets resolve successfully without mutating navigation destinations.
Persist machine-readable evidence plus screenshots/artifacts even when the product fails closed.
Keep the original browser verification job unresolved unless an actual representative CI/browser run satisfies its criteria.
Do not mutate Catalog, CURRENT_GRAPH, Current, Human Accepted or Served.
truth_boundary: This job only creates technical browser evidence through existing CI. It does not promote or rewrite product authority.
